Sarah,

Really appreciate the quick follow-up. I attached a concise onboarding MVP (onboarding-MVP-plan.pdf) and a starter json-schema-examples.json that maps to the three output shapes you mentioned (triage_event, patient_lookup_response, schedule_change). High level plan below — I kept it intentionally minimal so your procurement/engineering teams can agree quickly: 

MUTUAL ACTION PLAN (6 weeks)
1) Week 0-1: Kickoff + security review (SOC2 scope, network egress list) — Redwood to provide evidence.
2) Week 1-2: Schema alignment & example payloads — review with MediSys engineers.
3) Week 2-4: Integration: streaming endpoint + function/tool-calling hook for EMR lookup. Test harness and mock function provided by Redwood.
4) Week 4-5: Pilot validation: latency and correctness tests, schema conformance validation.
5) Week 5-6: Retrospective, handoff to CS for production enablement or Dedicated planning.

Open items (for your team):
- Confirm if logs/audit events need to include PHI hashes or full identifiers (affects retention settings).
- Provide a small sample of expected event payloads (redact PHI).

Attachments:
- onboarding-MVP-plan.pdf (application/pdf, 1.1MB)
- json-schema-examples.json (application/json, 4KB)

Next steps: If that plan looks good I can book a 60-min kickoff with our Solutions and Security folks tomorrow or Thursday.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks

Hi Sarah — adding the CS implementation perspective.

Thanks Dylan for the materials. Quick clarifications from the onboarding/ops side so we can size integration work:
- Streaming: we support chunked streaming responses (SSE/HTTP2) and incremental structured events. For your triage flow, we recommend a 600ms SLO per chunk for interactive UX.
- Function/tool calling: Redwood can host the function router or allow you to call out to a webhook in your VPC. Which do you prefer? Hosting simplifies the pilot; VPC webhook gives you full control.
- Structured outputs & schemas: we will run schema validation during the pilot and produce a daily conformance report. If you have a CI gate we can post a JSON schema artifact to your Drive link each night.

Proposed kickoff slots: Thu 11 Feb 14:00-15:00 PT or Fri 12 Feb 09:00-10:00 PT — please confirm one and we will send invites (security + solutions + CS).

Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Connors <sarah.connors@medsys.com>; laura_bennett@redwood.com; dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: ops@medsys.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 15:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot kickoff — streaming + function/tool-calling + structured outputs

Sarah — quick technical note and sample snippets to reduce friction on the first integration call.

1) Streaming behavior:
- We expose a /v1/stream endpoint that starts with a handshake and emits JSON Lines (one JSON object per event).
- Schema for each event: {
  "event_type": "string",
  "timestamp": "ISO8601",
  "payload": { /* typed per schema */ }
}
(Full examples attached in json-schema-examples.json)

2) Function/tool calling pattern (example pseudo-flow):
- Model emits a structured tool call: {"tool": "emr_lookup", "args": {"patient_id": "12345"}}
- Redwood routes call to the configured integration (hosted router or webhook) and returns result as a subsequent structured event.

3) JSON schema conformance checks we run during pilot:
- Draft conformance report snapshot attached (we will provide daily reports): each report lists non-conforming keys, type mismatches, and sample offending payloads.

4) Security note: for VPC webhook mode we will sign tool-call payloads with a short-lived HMAC; you can rotate the key.

Attachments included again: json-schema-examples.json (shows triage_event/patient_lookup_response/schedule_change shapes).

Small code snippet (curl) to consume streaming endpoint:
curl -N -H \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream?session=ms-2237 | while read line; do echo \"EVENT: $line\"; done

Happy to walk through these on the kickoff. If you confirm Thu 11 Feb 14:00 PT we will send calendar invites with a short agenda.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
